arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
# November 1979 (from 1980-11 bulletin page 148)
total_1979 = 1574
interest_1979 = 7
ratio_1979 = interest_1979 / total_1979

# November 1980 (from 1981-11 bulletin page 140)
total_1980 = 1938
interest_1980 = 10
ratio_1980 = interest_1980 / total_1980

# November 1981 (from 1982-11 bulletin page 112)
total_1981 = 2608
interest_1981 = 5
ratio_1981 = interest_1981 / total_1981

print(f"Nov 1979: Interest={interest_1979}, Total={total_1979}, Ratio={ratio_1979:.10f}")
print(f"Nov 1980: Interest={interest_1980}, Total={total_1980}, Ratio={ratio_1980:.10f}")
print(f"Nov 1981: Interest={interest_1981}, Total={total_1981}, Ratio={ratio_1981:.10f}")

ratios = [ratio_1979, ratio_1980, ratio_1981]
print(f"\nRatios: {ratios}")

highest = max(ratios)
lowest = min(ratios)
print(f"Highest ratio: {highest:.10f}")
print(f"Lowest ratio:  {lowest:.10f}")

abs_diff = abs(highest - lowest)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {abs_diff:.10f}")

rounded = round(abs_diff, 5)
print(f"Rounded to 5 decimal places: {rounded}")
PY
